Values of every kind cross modules; equality and hashing work on them.
-- main.star --
load("v.star", "S", "T", "D", "F", "mk")
print(S, T, D, F(2), mk(1) == mk(1), {mk(2): 1}[mk(2)])
print(sorted(S | set([0])), T[1:], D.get("b"), hash("x"))
-- v.star --
S = set([3, 1, 2])
T = (1, "two", 3.0, None, True)
D = {"a": [1], "b": {"c": (2,)}}
F = lambda x: x * 3
def mk(n):
    return struct(n = n, tag = "t")
